events.title: Cayucos Antique Street Faire – Fall Edition
events.venue: Ocean Avenue (Cayucos Drive to E Street), Cayucos
events.summary: 100+ antique & collectible vendors fill pedestrian-only Ocean Ave, 7 am–3 pm. Street closed 3 am–5 pm for setup/breakdown.

events.title: 35th Annual Cayucos Car Show
events.summary: Classic cars line downtown Cayucos, 8 am–4 pm, rain or shine. Live band, beer garden & Lions BBQ lunch. Check-in party Fri Nov 6 at Nelson's Garage.
